children-library.observed_description: A boy and a girl read picture books at a wooden table between full library shelves; the library reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; no letters; natural hands.

mother-pharmacy.observed_description: The smiling mother takes a white paper bag from a pharmacist in a white coat at a counter under a green pharmacy cross and medicine shelves; the cross and the mother stay in the 4:5 crop; no letters.

grandfather-bank.observed_description: The grey-haired grandfather in a green cardigan uses a cash machine set into a columned stone bank front; bank reads through the machine and columns at 180 px; blank screen, no letters.

father-station.observed_description: The father with a backpack smiles on a station platform beside a train with open doors, yellow platform edge and overhead wires; the station reads at every size; the far display is unreadable blur.

man-points-left.observed_description: Luis faces the camera and points to the viewer's left with his RIGHT arm, so from his own side he points right; ambiguous for teaching Left. Replaced by a back view (man-points-left-back) where his left is the viewer's left.

children-walk-school.observed_description: A boy and a girl with backpacks walk side by side along a sunny sidewalk toward a low brick school with a fenced yard; walking reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; the small plaque is blank.

girl-near-school.observed_description: The girl with a purple T-shirt and backpack stands right at the brick-and-metal school gate with the school building and playground just behind her; near reads clearly at 180 px.

boy-near-station.observed_description: The boy in a blue polo stands against the wooden station building on the platform, touching its wall, with a train at the platform behind him; near the station reads at every size.

bank-left.observed_description: Quiet stone street: the columned bank with an ATM fills the left side and the white pharmacy with a green cross and shelves fills the right; the sides read at 180 px; the 4:5 crop loses the pharmacy, so the pack keeps it out of four-picture cards.

review-woman-at-library.observed_description: A red-haired woman in a mustard sweater takes a book from tall library shelves; the library reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; no letters on spines.

review-walk-to-work.observed_description: A man in a blazer with a satchel and a coffee walks along a sunny city sidewalk on his way to work; the storefront signs behind are soft out-of-focus shapes that stay unreadable even at full size.

review-car-far.observed_description: A park bench under trees in the foreground and a small white building with a red cross far away across open fields; far reads well; the hospital is tiny at grid size, so the review uses it only as a full-width picture.

review-hospital-on-the-right.observed_description: An empty street: a brick building with bookshelves in its windows on the left and a white building with a large red cross on the right; on the right reads at 180 px; four_card false because the crop loses the sides.

review-wait-red-light.observed_description: A young man with a backpack waits at the curb under a red pedestrian light while cars pass over the striped crossing; cannot cross reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; plates blank.

review-taxi.observed_description: An older couple gets into a yellow taxi with a blank roof sign on a stone street; taxi and two people read at every size and in the 4:5 crop; no letters.

man-points-left-back.observed_description: Luis seen from behind at a fork in a village street stretches his LEFT arm to the left of the photo and looks left in profile, so his left and the viewer's left agree; reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop.

children-school-bus.observed_description: The same boy and girl from the walking photo climb into a yellow school bus at the curb in front of the brick school; the bus reads at every size and in the 4:5 crop; no letters on the bus.

girl-far-from-school.observed_description: The same girl with her purple T-shirt and backpack stands in the foreground of a long dirt road between fields, with the low brick school tiny on the horizon; far reads against the near photo at every size; she stays whole in the 4:5 crop.

boy-far-from-station.observed_description: The same boy in the blue polo stands in a grassy field in the foreground while the small station building and its train sit far away across the valley; far reads against the near photo at every size and in the 4:5 crop.

bank-right.observed_description: Exact mirror of the bank-left street: the white pharmacy with the green cross now fills the left side and the columned bank with the ATM fills the right; only the sides changed; reads at 180 px; kept out of four-picture cards.

man-points-right.observed_description: Same back view, crossroads and light as the left photo: Luis now stretches his RIGHT arm to the right of the photo and looks right in profile, left arm down; reads at 180 px; the 4:5 crop trims the fingertip but keeps the direction.
